papers.title_en: Wasserstein regularity of vorticity solutions to the 2D Navier-Stokes equations
papers.evidence: 直接研究NS方程的Wasserstein几何正则性
papers.tldr: 本研究针对二维Navier-Stokes方程涡度解的正则性问题，通过将涡度流视为Wasserstein空间中的绝对连续曲线，证明了对于p∈[1,2]，涡度解在W_p空间中具有绝对连续性。这一发现揭示了涡度解在概率度量空间中的规律性，为理解流体动力学方程的长期行为提供了新视角，并推广了相关正则性理论。
papers.abstract_en: One proves that the the vorticity flow of 2D Navier Stokes equation can be identified with an absolutely continuous curve in Wasserstein space W_{p} where p\in [1,2}.

papers.title_en: Isolated Singularities of Solutions to the Yamabe Equation with boundary in Dimension 3 and 4
papers.evidence: 边界Yamabe方程孤立奇点的渐近行为
papers.tldr: 本文研究非共形平坦度量下边界Yamabe方程正解在孤立奇点附近的渐近行为。在三维和四维情形，建立了解的上界估计及不可移除奇点处的匹配下界，从而给出可移除性的充要条件。进一步证明不可移除奇点解具有渐近圆柱对称性，无需借助Fowler型分类。该工作将平半空间理论推广到非平坦边界，并提供了内部理论的边界类比。
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the asymptotic behavior of positive solutions to the boundary Yamabe equation near an isolated singularity when the metric is not conformally flat. In dimensions 3 and 4, we establishes the sharp upper bound and, in the non-removable case, the matching lower bound, which also gives a necessary and sufficient condition for removability. Moreover, every solution with a non-removable singularity is shown to be asymptotically cylindrically symmetric, without relying on a global classification of Fowler-type singular solutions. These results aslo extend the flat half-space theory of Caffarelli-Jin-Sire-Xiong (2014) to non-flat boundary geometries and provide boundary analogues of the interior theories developed by Marques (2008) and Xiong-Zhang (2022).

papers.title_en: A lecture on Navier-Stokes equations
papers.evidence: 讲义涵盖NS方程的存在唯一性证明
papers.tldr: Navier-Stokes方程是流体力学核心，其解的存在唯一性在临界空间中仍是难题。本讲义从Fourier变换和Sobolev空间基础出发，以非线性热方程为玩具模型，逐步推进至Navier-Stokes系统。最终证明了Navier-Stokes方程在临界空间中的温和解的存在唯一性。该12周自包含讲义包含习题和考试，为教学提供系统参考。
papers.abstract_en: The content of the following pages was part of a special topics lecture given at the Australian National University during the first semester of 2026. That was a very nice expericence, I really enjoyed giving this 12 weeks (2 hours a week) lecture. It is meant to be self contained, starting with results on Fourier transform and Sobolev spaces. As a toy model, before treating the Navier-Stokes system, we focus on the non linear heat equation where the non linearity is polynomial. Ultimately, we prove existence and uniqueness of mild solutions of the Navier-Stokes equations in critical spaces. This script contains some exercises and the text of the mid-semester exam as well as the final exam.

papers.title_en: On the Critical One Components Regularity for the $3-D$ Navier-Stokes System in $L^p_T(\dot{B}^{\frac 1 2+\frac 2 p}_{2,\infty})$ spaces
papers.authors: Wei Luo, Zhanyang Yin, Pei Zheng
papers.evidence: Navier-Stokes 正则性，临界单分量条件
papers.tldr: 三维Navier-Stokes方程的正则性是流体力学核心难题，特别是初始数据在临界空间中的解。本文针对初始速度属于H^{1/2}且涡量属于L^{r0}的温和解，研究了在L^p_T(\dot{B}^{\frac 1 2+\frac 2 p}_{2,\infty})空间中的单个分量正则性。核心方法是利用速度场在单位方向上的投影的范数积分，证明若解在有限时间T*爆破，则该积分必然发散。关键结果是对于任意2<p<∞和单位向量e，积分爆炸，改进了Chemin等和Han等的结果，为理解三维Navier-Stokes方程可能的奇性提供了更精细的条件。
papers.abstract_en: We consider the conditional regularity of the mild solution $v$ of the $3-D$ incompressible Navier-Stokes equations with initial data $v_0\in \dot{H}^{\frac 1 2}$ and vorticity $Ω_0\in L^{r_0}$ for some $r_0\in (1,2)$. We prove that if the solution associated with initial data $v_0$ blows up at a finite time $T^\ast$, then for any $2<p<\infty$, and any unit vectors $e$ in $\mathbb{R}^3$, the integral   $$\int_0^{T^\ast}\left\Vert (v(t)|e)_{\mathbb{R}^3}\right\Vert_{\dot{B}^{\frac 1 2+\frac 2 p}_{2,\infty}}^p{\rm d}t$$ blows up at $T^\ast$. The conclusion improves the recent results in Chemin et al. (Arch Ration Mech Anal 224(3):871-905, 2017) and Han et al. (Arch. Rational Mech. Anal. 231:939-970, 2019).

papers.title_en: On the sharpness of bounds on the rate of growth of Lebesgue norms of the velocity in Navier-Stokes flows
papers.evidence: Navier-Stokes，Lebesgue范数增长率，界的最优性
papers.tldr: 本文研究三维Navier-Stokes系统中速度Lebesgue范数增长率的一类先验上界的尖锐性。通过构造优化问题并采用黎曼共轭梯度法数值求解，寻找使增长率最大化的速度场。结果表明该界在数值预因子意义下是尖锐的，无法根本改进，且当范数指数趋近于3时增长率发散。这一发现验证了Ladyzhenskaya-Prodi-Serrin条件在刻画经典解时的紧致性。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we consider solutions $\boldsymbol{u}$ of the three-dimensional Navier-Stokes system and investigate sharpness of the a priori bound \begin{align*} \frac{d}{dt}\|\boldsymbol{u}\|_q^q \leq C\|\boldsymbol{u}\|_q^{q\frac{q-1}{q-3}}, \qquad q > 3. \end{align*} This bound is closely related to the Ladyzhenskaya-Prodi-Serrin conditions characterizing classical solutions of the Navier-Stokes system. Velocity fields maximizing the rate of growth $(d/dt)\|\boldsymbol{u}\|_q^q$ under certain constraints are found as solutions of a suitable optimization problem which is solved numerically using a Riemannian conjugate gradient approach. The results obtained for different $q$ and increasing values of $\|\boldsymbol{u}\|_q$ indicate that the bound is indeed sharp, up to a numerical prefactor, and therefore cannot be fundamentally improved. Additionally, the results also suggest that the rate of growth $(d/dt)\|\boldsymbol{u}\|_q^q$ diverges as $q\to 3$.

papers.title_en: Global solutions to the Navier--Stokes equations with large vertical velocities in $\dot{B}_{\infty,σ}^{-1}(\mathbb{R}^3)$
papers.evidence: Navier-Stokes方程，全局存在性，临界Besov空间的几何分析
papers.tldr: 针对三维不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程Cauchy问题，当水平速度在临界Besov空间（如Fujita-Kato类）中小而垂直速度在$\dot{B}_{\infty,\sigma}^{-1}(\mathbb{R}^3)$（$1\le\sigma<\infty$）中任意大时，仍可证明存在唯一整体解。该方法利用各向异性估计与精细的Besov空间性质，突破了传统小性假设对垂直分量的限制。主要结果：在垂直速度任意大的情况下，只要水平分量足够小，方程就有唯一整体解。这一工作揭示了Navier-Stokes方程在特定大垂直速度下的适定性，为理解复杂流动提供了新视角。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider the Cauchy problem for the $3$D incompressible Navier--Stokes equations and prove the existence of unique global solutions in the framework that the horizontal component of the velocity field is small in some critical Besov spaces including the classical Fujita--Kato class, while the vertical component is large in the wide class $\dot{B}_{\infty,σ}^{-1}(\mathbb{R}^3)$ ($1 \leq σ< \infty$) where the Navier--Stokes equations are known to be ill-posed in.

papers.title_en: Logarithmic Depletion of Vortex Stretching and Singularity Evasion in the 3D Navier-Stokes Equations
papers.evidence: Navier-Stokes方程的几何分析机制
papers.tldr: 针对三维Navier-Stokes方程临界点奇点（涡量L^{3/2,∞}空间集中）情形，本文提出一种几何分析机制来抑制有限时间奇点。当涡量方向局部位于对数加权有界平均振荡空间（bmo_{1/|log r|}）时，通过单向几何抵消将非线性涡旋拉伸特征值重构为奇异积分交换子，并利用局部Coifman-Rochberg-Weiss估计与dyadic BMO尾界，证明拉伸势在超水平集上以对数包络衰减。该衰减迫使涡量大小进入次临界Lorentz-Zygmund空间，并通过对数增益传递至速度场，使其局部一维稀疏几何尺度低于空间解析性均匀半径。最终通过调和测度最大值原理，避免了有限时间爆破。
papers.abstract_en: We present a geometric-analytic mechanism for the suppression of finite-time singularities in the 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes equations for critical point singularities exhibiting $L^{3/2, \infty}$ spatial concentration of vorticity. We demonstrate that if the vorticity direction resides locally in a logarithmically weighted space of bounded mean oscillations, $\mathrm{bmo}_{1/|\log r|}$ -- a space failing the Dini condition and thus permitting wild oscillatory defects -- the non-linear vortex stretching is fundamentally depleted. By isolating a unidirectional geometric cancellation, we recast the stretching eigenvalue as a singular integral commutator. Utilizing a localized Coifman-Rochberg-Weiss estimate coupled with dyadic BMO tail bounds, we prove the stretching potential vanishes as a logarithmic envelope on shrinking super-level sets. This depletion forces the vorticity magnitude into a sub-critical Lorentz-Zygmund space via interpolated De Giorgi energy method. The logarithmic gain is subsequently transferred to the velocity field, forcing the geometric scale of local 1D sparseness below the uniform radius of spatial analyticity, ultimately averting the finite-time blow-up via the harmonic measure maximum principle.

papers.title_en: $L^2(\mathbb{R}^2)$ Well-Posedness and Logarithmic Lipschitz Regularity for the Density Patch Problem
papers.evidence: 非均匀Navier-Stokes系统密度斑块的适定性和对数Lipschitz正则性
papers.tldr: 二维非齐次不可压缩Navier-Stokes系统带真空的密度斑块问题，初始数据为Lipschitz密度斑块和L^2无散度速度场。通过能量估计和对数Lipschitz估计，证明了L^2水平的整体适定性及解的唯一性，并将Chemin-Lerner经典结果推广到非齐次情形。作为推论，速度场属于L^∞_t C_x^{1-ε}，确保斑块边界保持Hausdorff维数1的连续曲线，从而维持初始维数。
papers.abstract_en: We study the density patch problem for the two-dimensional inhomogeneous incompressible Navier--Stokes system with vacuum, for initial data consisting of a Lipschitz density patch and a divergence-free velocity field in $L^2(\mathbb{R}^2)$.   We establish uniqueness of solutions at the natural energy level, thereby concluding the global well-posedness for $L^2$ data.   Furthermore, we prove a log-Lipschitz estimate for the velocity field, extending the classical result of Chemin-Lerner to the inhomogeneous setting. As a consequence, the associated flow belongs to $L^\infty_t C_x^{1-\varepsilon}$. for any $\varepsilon \in (0,1)$, ensuring that the patch boundary remains a continuous curve of Hausdorff dimension $1$, thus preserving its initial dimension for all time.

papers.title_en: Blow-up phenomena for the $σ_2$-Yamabe equation
papers.authors: Bin Deng, Han Lu, Jun-cheng Wei
papers.evidence: 在球面上具有对径不变度量的σ2-Yamabe方程爆破现象
papers.tldr: 针对σ2-Yamabe方程在高维球面上的爆破现象，现有研究多限于低维或局部共形平坦背景。本文构造了S^n（n≥27）上反极点对称且非局部共形平坦的光滑度量，使得归一化方程存在非紧致的正Γ2+可容许解族。核心困难在于线性化算子可能丧失椭圆性，这是因为标准泡的牛顿张量远场衰减与背景度量项衰减不同步。通过有限维约化并引入四次型轮廓，保证相对衰减使解始终落在椭圆性锥内，最终确定端点维度n=27。该工作揭示了高阶曲率方程中背景度量非平坦性引发的全新爆破机制，拓展了Yamabe问题的研究范畴。
papers.abstract_en: For every integer $n\ge27$, we construct a smooth metric on $\mathbb S^n$ that is invariant under the antipodal map and is not locally conformally flat. For this fixed background metric, the normalized $σ_2$-Yamabe equation admits a noncompact family of positive $Γ_2^+$-admissible solutions. The main difficulty is the possible loss of ellipticity of the linearized operator. This difficulty does not occur for the scalar Yamabe equation, whose linearization has a fixed Laplace-type principal part. In the $σ_2$ problem, the positive Newton tensor of a standard bubble decays in the far field, while the terms produced by the background metric need not decay at the same rate. Our construction provides the relative decay needed to keep the conformal metrics inside the ellipticity cone. A quartic profile in the finite-dimensional reduction yields the endpoint dimension $n=27$.

papers.title_en: Homothetic Self-Similar Solutions to the Incompressible Navier-Stokes Equations
papers.evidence: 位似自相似解，Navier-Stokes
papers.tldr: 本文研究不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程的同位自相似解，即解及其β倍均为自相似剖面。在三维正则初始条件下，通过Liouville定理证明不存在非平凡同位解；在二维中，唯一衰减同位解是Oseen涡。进一步分析显示，Oseen涡附近线性化Euler算子稳定，但存在不稳定近似特征值。该工作限制了自相似解的存在性，为Jia-Šverák程序证明Leray-Hopf解非唯一性提供关键依据。
papers.abstract_en: We investigate homothetic forward self-similar solutions of the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations: the solutions $\overline{U}$ for which both $\overline{U}$ and $β\overline{U}$ are self-similar profiles for some nontrivial $β$. Homothetic solutions are, in addition, the only solutions for which a singular limit argument can be used to prove non-uniqueness of Leray-Hopf solutions along the lines of the Jia-Šverák program. In three dimensions, and for sufficiently regular initial data, we prove a Liouville theorem that rules out the existence of non-trivial homothetic solutions. In two dimensions, our Liouville theorem proves that the only decaying homothetic solution is the Oseen vortex. In addition, we prove that the Euler operator linearized around the Oseen vortex is stable. On the other hand, we also discover a homothetic solution for which an unstable approximate eigenvalue of the linearized Euler operator exists.

papers.title_en: One thousand and one higher-order geometric flows of networks
papers.evidence: 曲线和网络的高阶几何流
papers.tldr: 针对一大类高阶几何流曲线和网络，该研究证明了其在L²梯度流下的短时间存在唯一性（模参数化）。通过能量方法，进一步获得了长时间存在性结果。这些流涉及曲率导数的高阶泛函，扩展了几何流理论。
papers.abstract_en: We show short-time existence and uniqueness up to reparametrization for a large class of higher-order geometric flows of curves and networks obtained as $L^2$-gradient flow of higher-order functionals involving derivatives of the curvature. Additionally, we prove a long-time existence result via energy methods.

papers.title_en: Regularity and Decay for Navier-Slip Fluid-Structure Interaction in Exterior Domains
papers.evidence: 利用球的几何正则性研究NS类型方程的正则性和衰减
papers.tldr: 针对全空间中带摩擦纳维滑移边界条件的球形刚体-不可压缩粘性流体线性耦合系统，已有研究仅在有界域中获得半群估计。本文利用球面几何正则性，建立了该流体-结构算子的强L^q正则性、有界解析性和尖锐L^q-L^r衰减估计，为非线性系统的强解与Kato型解构造奠定了理论基础。
papers.abstract_en: We study the linearized motion of a spherical rigid body immersed in an incompressible viscous fluid occupying the whole space, under Navier slip boundary conditions with friction. While semigroup regularity and decay estimates are well understood for the no-slip case, such results have been limited to bounded domains in the slip setting. By exploiting the geometric regularity of the sphere, we establish strong $L^q$-regularity, bounded analyticity, and sharp $ L^q-L^r$ estimates for the corresponding fluid-structure operator. These results would provide a foundation for constructing strong $W^{2,1}_q$ solutions and Kato-type solutions to the corresponding nonlinear system.

papers.title_en: On Leray's Theoreme de Structure for a weak solution to the Navier-Stokes equations: an improvement of the result
papers.evidence: Leray结构定理，Navier-Stokes弱解
papers.tldr: 针对Navier-Stokes方程弱解的Leray结构定理，本文提出改进。已有定理给出了弱解正则区间的一个无界区间，但其左端点估计不够精确。通过引入新的能量估计方法，对弱解在可能奇异点附近的局部行为进行分析，得到了左端点的一个新的上界。该结果提升了结构定理的精度，加深了对弱解正则性结构的理解。
papers.abstract_en: In this note we furnish a new result concerning the well known théorème de structure by Leray related to a weak solution to the Navier-Stokes equations. We are able to furnish a new estimate on the left endpoint of the unbounded interval of regularity.

papers.title_en: Global well-posedness of isentropic compressible Navier--Stokes equations with smallness on scaling-invariant quantity in a half-space
papers.evidence: Navier-Stokes方程，全局适定性，半空间，存在性
papers.tldr: 研究三维等熵可压缩Navier-Stokes方程在上半空间带滑移边界条件的初边值问题，允许真空和大振幅振荡。利用系统的自然缩放结构，识别出一个缩放不变的初始量，该量由密度、速度、压力及梯度的范数组合而成。证明当该初始量充分小时，强解整体存在且唯一。该结果为Cauchy问题的缩放不变全局理论提供了半空间对应，并验证了滑移边界条件的兼容性。
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the initial-boundary value problem for the three-dimensional isentropic compressible   Navier--Stokes equations in the upper half-space with the slip boundary   conditions. We prove the global existence and uniqueness of strong   solutions in the presence of vacuum and large oscillations.   Although scaling frameworks for compressible flows in domains with   boundaries have been developed in several settings, the global well-posedness result in the half-space remains far from complete. The system with far-field vacuum admits a natural scaling   structure that preserves both the half-space geometry and the slip   boundary conditions. Motivated by this scaling, we identify the following   \textit{scaling-invariant initial quantity}:   $$   \left[   \|ρ_{0}\|_{L^{\infty}}^3   \left(   \frac12\|\sqrt{ρ_0} u_0\|_{L^{2}}^{2}   +\frac{1}{γ-1}\|P(ρ_{0})\|_{L^{1}}   \right)   +\|ρ_{0}\|_{L^{\infty}}^{\frac{3-γ}{2}}   \right]   \left(   \|\nabla u_0\|_{L^2}^2   +\|P(ρ_{0})\|_{L^2}^2   \right).   $$   Under the assumption that this quantity is sufficiently small, we establish the global well-posedness of strong solutions. This result provides a half-space counterpart of the scaling-invariant global theory for the Cauchy problem established by Wen (Adv. Math. 482 (2025), Paper No. 110628) and shows that the slip boundary condition is compatible with the system.

papers.title_en: On existence of a collapsed bubble with surface tension in viscous incompressible fluid
papers.evidence: 存在性：带表面张力的Navier-Stokes自由边界问题中气泡塌缩的存在性
papers.tldr: 研究粘性不可压缩流体中带表面张力的气泡自由边界问题，初始域为气泡外部（或有界域）。为构造有限时间坍缩而不发生边界主曲率爆炸的溅射奇点，引入带δ-翼的域概念，这是一个平坦黎曼流形，覆盖边界自交的δ邻域。通过该几何方法，证明了在Navier-Stokes方程框架下，存在这样的坍缩解，且曲率保持有界。此工作揭示了表面张力作用下奇点形成的可能性，对理解自由边界的破裂机制有重要意义。
papers.abstract_en: We consider the one-phase free boundary problem for the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations in $\mathbb{R}^d$ ($d\ge2$). The surface tension is taken into account. The initial domain, which is the outside of a bubble, is an exterior domain. We prove that there exists a bubble evolving by this free boundary problem which collapses in a finite time without blowing up of principal curvatures of its boundary. In other words, what is called a splash singularity is formed in a finite time. This type of result is also valid for a bounded initial domain. To construct such an example, we introduce the notion of a domain with $δ$-wing which is a flat Riemannian manifold that is not embedded in $\mathbb{R}^d$, but it covers the $δ$-neighborhood of the original domain whose boundary is self-intersected.

papers.title_en: Existence of weak solutions of the surface Beris-Edwards model
papers.authors: Gonzalo A. Benavides, Ricardo H. Nochetto, Mansur Shakipov
papers.evidence: 表面Beris-Edwards模型弱解的存在性，耦合切向Navier-Stokes方程
papers.tldr: 针对曲面液晶的Beris-Edwards模型，该模型耦合了不可压缩切向Navier-Stokes方程与Q-tensor场的动力学方程，本文证明其弱解的存在性。采用基于切向Stokes算子和张量值Laplace-Beltrami算子特征函数的Faedo-Galerkin格式，并通过标准紧性论证恢复弱解。结果为该热力学一致模型在闭超曲面上的数学理论提供了基础。
papers.abstract_en: We prove the existence of weak solutions to the surface Beris-Edwards model for nematic liquid crystals posed on a $d$-dimensional ($d \in \{2,3\}$) closed hypersurface of class $C^{2,1}$. This thermodynamically consistent model, recently introduced by Bouck, Nochetto and Yushutin (2024), couples the incompressible tangent Navier-Stokes equations with a kinematic equation for the Q-tensor field that encodes the orientation of the liquid crystal particles with a general state of orientational order. Extending ideas by Abels, Dolzmann and Liu (2014) and Guillén-González and Rodríguez-Bellido (2015) for the Beris-Edwards model in flat domains, we design a Faedo-Galerkin scheme based upon eigenfunctions of an appropriate tangent Stokes operator and tensor-valued Laplace-Beltrami operator and recover a weak solution via standard compactness arguments.

papers.title_en: Higher regularity of the inverse anisotropic mean curvature flow
papers.authors: Chaoqun Gao, Yong Wei, Rong Zhou
papers.evidence: 几何流，平均曲率流正则性
papers.tldr: 针对逆各向异性平均曲率流，本文证明了Huisken-Ilmanen高正则性定理的各向异性版本。首先对光滑闭严格星形解建立了Harnack估计，然后从具有有界非负弱各向异性平均曲率的C^1严格星形超曲面构造出全局光滑解。结合弱解渐近理论，证明了从有界光滑初始集出发的弱解在紧集外变为光滑。该结果将经典的正则性理论推广到了各向异性情形。
papers.abstract_en: We prove an anisotropic analogue of the higher regularity theorem of Huisken and Ilmanen for inverse mean curvature flow. For an arbitrary smooth Minkowski norm, we first prove a Huisken--Ilmanen type Harnack estimate for smooth closed strictly star-shaped solutions. We then construct global smooth solutions starting from $C^1$ strictly star-shaped hypersurfaces with bounded nonnegative weak anisotropic mean curvature. Combining this construction with the asymptotic theory for weak inverse anisotropic mean curvature flow, we show that weak solutions starting from bounded smooth initial sets become smooth outside a compact set.

papers.title_en: Regularity of a Geodesic equation in the space of mixed Volume Forms on Hermitian Manifolds
papers.evidence: Hermite流形上测地线方程的正则性
papers.tldr: 该论文研究Hermitian流形上混合体积形式空间中的测地线方程的正则性。在椭圆性条件下，利用一致Laplacian估计和显式子解，证明退化方程存在C^{1,1}解。特别地，由此得到Hermitian流形上Donaldson方程存在唯一C^{1,1}解，为相关几何问题提供了新工具。
papers.abstract_en: We prove regularity of a fully nonlinear equation that arises from the study of geodesics in the space of mixed volume forms on Hermitian manifolds admitting a balanced metric. Under conditions for ellipticity, we prove that this degenerate equation has a $C^{1,1}$ solution on Hermitian manifolds. We derive uniform Laplacian estimates for the perturbed equation, and also construct explicit subsolutions. In particular, this shows the existence of a unique $C^{1,1}$ solution to the Donaldson equation on Hermitian manifolds.

papers.title_en: De Giorgi varifold solutions to Mean Curvature Flow: a minimizing movements approach
papers.evidence: 为平均曲率流提出新的存在性证明，属于几何偏微分方程
papers.tldr: 平均曲率流和保体积平均曲率流的全局弱解存在性是几何分析中的重要问题。现有最小移动方案通常依赖比较原理，且收敛性有条件限制。本文提出纯变分的最小移动方案，首次证明其无条件收敛到De Giorgi varifold解。关键创新在于引入一个替代完全退化L^2距离的鲁棒代理，不依赖比较原理，为弱解存在性提供了新方法。
papers.abstract_en: We propose an alternative existence proof of global weak solutions to mean curvature flow and volume preserving mean curvature flow. We prove for the first time for a minimizing movements scheme the unconditional convergence towards a varifold solution, here a De Giorgi solution. The argument is purely variational and does not rely on comparison principles. The key novelty is an alternative proxy for the completely degenerate $L^2$ distance that is more robust than the one of Almgren-Taylor-Wang and Luckhaus-Sturzenhecker.

papers.title_en: Strict Convexity for Solution of Liouville-Type Dirichlet Problems
papers.evidence: Liouville型Dirichlet问题，严格凸性，几何PDE
papers.tldr: 本文研究三类Liouville型Dirichlet问题（Δu=e^u, σ_2(D^2u)=e^{2u}, σ_2(u_{i\bar j})=e^{2u}）在光滑一致凸区域上的凸性结构。通过引入变换w=-arcosh(e^{-u/2})，结合区域变形、常秩理论、逆凸性估计、径向球模型、边界严格凸性和局部C^2稳定性，证明了w在实变量下严格凸。该结果揭示了这些指数型方程共同的凸性特征，为解的正则性和几何性质提供了新见解。
papers.abstract_en: We identify a common convexity structure for three exponential Dirichlet problems on smooth uniformly strictly convex domains: the Liouville equation $Δu=e^u$, the real equation $σ_2(D^2u)=e^{2u}$, and its complex counterpart $σ_2(u_{i\bar j})=e^{2u}$. In each case $u<0$ in the domain and $u=0$ on the boundary. We prove that \[ w=-\operatorname{arcosh}(e^{-u/2}) \] is strictly convex in the underlying real variables. The argument combines domain deformation, constant-rank theory, inverse-convexity estimates, radial ball models, boundary strict convexity, and local $C^2$ stability.

papers.title_en: Absence of blow-up in the 3D Navier-Stokes equations with transport noise
papers.evidence: 三维Navier-Stokes方程带传输噪声的存在性与正则性
papers.tldr: 三维Navier-Stokes方程全局光滑解的存在性是长期未解决的公开问题。本文引入一类物理上合理的传输噪声作为随机扰动，利用其与对流项的相容性，证明该随机偏微分方程以高概率存在全局光滑解。该正则化效应对任意大的光滑初值一致成立，且不依赖于初值大小。这一结果为理解湍流模型中的随机正则化机制提供了新视角。
papers.abstract_en: Establishing the global-in-time smoothness of solutions to the 3D Navier-Stokes equations (NSEs) with large initial data remains a long-standing open problem. In this paper, we prove that the 3D NSEs driven by a suitably chosen transport noise -- a physically motivated stochastic perturbation -- admit global-in-time smooth solutions with high probability. This regularizing effect holds uniformly for initial data in arbitrarily large balls of subcritical function spaces with positive smoothness.

papers.title_en: Geometric Gradient Flows from Elliptic Level Sets: Normal Decomposition and Reflection Dynamics
papers.evidence: 几何梯度流，椭圆水平集，法向分解
papers.tldr: 研究椭圆型Dirichlet问题解的移动水平集几何。通过将水平集法向场分解为静态径向法向、驱动项和曲率余项，在薄壳假设下建立离散反射映射。证明切向位移满足二次误差控制，且轨道近似连续梯度流。理论分析与FEniCS数值实验验证了收敛性，为椭圆方程几何分析提供新框架。
papers.abstract_en:
We investigate the asymptotic geometry of shifting superlevel sets $Ω_t = \{x \in Ω: u(x) > t\}$ generated by solutions to the elliptic Dirichlet problem $-Δu = f$ in $Ω$, where the non-negative source $f 
ot\equiv 0$ is compactly supported within a strictly convex inner core $C \subset Ω$. Under a quantitative radial monotonicity condition, each boundary $\partialΩ_t$ is a smooth normal graph over $\partial C$ characterized by a thickness function $d_t \in C^{1,α}(\partial C)$ tracking $d_0$ as $t 	o 0$.A central contribution is a rigorous decomposition of the inward unit normal field along the level surfaces: $\mathbf{n}_{Ω_t} = ν- 
abla_{\partial C} d_t + \mathcal{G} + \mathcal{P}$, where $ν$ is the static radial normal, $-
abla_{\partial C} d_t$ is the kinematic driving vector, and $\mathcal{G}, \mathcal{P}$ are curvature and PDE Hessian remainder operators.In a thin-shell configuration $(\Vert{}d_0\Vert{}_{C^1} \ll 1)$, we formalize a discrete specular point-reflection mapping $F_n$ on $\partial C$. We prove the tangential displacement satisfies $F_n(p) - p = -2d_n(p)
abla_{\partial C}d_n(p) + R_n(p)$, with quadratic control $\Vert{}R_n\Vert{}_{L^\infty} \le C\Vert{}d_n\Vert{}_{C^1}^2$. Using the energy $\mathcal{E}(t) = \int_{\partial C} d_t^2 \, d\mathcal{H}^{N-1}$, we show these orbits approximate a continuous gradient flow driven by $+

papers.title_en: Existence of semiglobal $W^{2,p}$-isometric immersions for negatively curved surface metrics with unbounded second fundamental form
papers.evidence: 通过Gauss-Codazzi PDEs证明等距浸入的存在性
papers.tldr: 论文研究负曲率曲面到三维欧氏空间的等距浸入存在性。将Gauss-Codazzi方程重新表述为带源项的Chaplygin气体流双曲守恒律，利用不变区域理论和补偿紧致方法，对多类一般度量（包括经典极小曲面、等温坐标或“倒数型”度量）建立任意有限指数p和大矩形域上的W^{2,p}等距浸入存在性。所构造浸入的第二基本形式可以无界但L^p可积。关键贡献在于将流体动力学形式与熵分析结合，处理Riemann不变量有界且异号的情形。
papers.abstract_en: This paper is concerned with the existence theory of isometric immersions of surfaces with negative Gaussian curvature into the 3-dimensional Euclidean space. We reformulate the Gauss--Codazzi equations, \emph{i.e.}, the partial differential equations for isometric immersions, into hyperbolic conservation laws for the flows of Chaplygin gas with nonzero source terms. Then, by employing the theories of invariant regions and compensated compactness, we establish the existence of $W^{2,p}$-isometric immersions for several general families of metrics, with any finite index $p$ and over arbitrarily large rectangular domains. Such metrics include various classical minimal surfaces: helicoid, catenoid, pseudosphere, and Enneper surfaces, as well as metrics in isothermal coordinates or of the ``reciprocal-type''. In our fluid dynamical formulation of the isometric immersion problem, we specialise in the case that the two Riemann invariants for the associated hyperbolic conservation law remain bounded and of distinctive signs, and obtain $L^p$-solutions to the initial-boundary value problem via entropy analysis. The isometric immersions constructed in this paper may have unbounded but $L^p$-integrable second fundamental forms.

papers.title_en: Modified Mean Curvature Flow in Fuchsian Manifolds
papers.evidence: 几何偏微分方程，Fuchsian流形中的平均曲率流
papers.tldr: Fuchsian流形中的平均曲率流研究受限于全局梯度界，而修正平均曲率流通过修改曲率项避免这一限制。本文证明从任意图开始的修正平均曲率流全局存在，并光滑收敛到常平均曲率的等距曲面。该结果推广了标准平均曲率流的工作，移除了原有的梯度界假设，显著简化了条件。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we show that the modified mean curvature flow starting from an arbitrary graph in a Fuchsian manifold exists for all time and converges smoothly to an equidistant surface of constant mean curvature as $t\to \infty$. This result generalizes earlier work to the modified mean curvature flow setting and removes the restrictive global gradient bound initially required for the standard mean curvature flow by Huang, Zhou, and the second author \cite{HLZ2020}.

papers.title_en: An $L^p$-theory for global weak solutions to the Navier-Stokes equations in exterior domains
papers.evidence: 外区域中Navier-Stokes方程全局弱解的L^p理论
papers.tldr: 针对外区域Navier-Stokes方程，建立了初始数据在L^p(p∈(2,3))空间的全局弱解存在性理论。证明弱解在某一时刻后成为正则解且几乎处处正则，给出了结构定理。该结果填补了外区域全局弱解L^p理论的空白，并适用于柯西问题和半空间情形。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider the Navier-Stokes initial boundary value problem in exterior domains with initial data in the Lebesgue space $L^p$, $p\in (2,3)$, and show the existence of a global weak solution. For the quoted solution, we also furnish a structure theorem. In particular, we see that the weak solution becomes regular after a certain instant of time and it is also regular a. e. in time. Although a general $L^p$-theory for local strong/mild solutions is well-established in the literature, a corresponding theory for global weak solutions in exterior domains seems to be new. Of course, our results hold in the particular cases of the Cauchy problem and the initial boundary value problem in a half-space.

papers.title_en: Equivariant Allen--Cahn Solutions and the Existence of Cohomogeneity $2$ Minimal Surfaces
papers.authors: Rayssa Caju, Pedro Gaspar, Jared Marx-Kuo
papers.evidence: 等变Allen-Cahn解与极小曲面存在性
papers.tldr: 本文研究闭黎曼流形上等变Allen-Cahn方程解的正则性，并证明余维2李群作用流形上极小超曲面的存在性。通过发展带漂移Laplacian的修正方程的正则性理论，推广了Chodosh-Mantoulidis的方法。对于余维3-7，解序列收敛到嵌入极小超曲面；余维2且无例外轨道时，收敛到浸入极小超曲面。还定义了等变Allen-Cahn p-宽度，并在极限下收敛到等变p-宽度。
papers.abstract_en: We develop a regularity theory for equivariant Allen--Cahn solutions on closed Riemannian manifolds with a Lie group acting isometrically. When the cohomogeneity of the action is between $3$ and $7$, we show that a sequence of equivariant Allen--Cahn solutions with uniformly bounded energy and equivariant index converge to embedded minimal hypersurfaces with optimal regularity, meaning that the singular set is at least codimension $7$ and lies in the union of all non-principal orbits. When the cohomogeneity is $2$ and the action has no exceptional orbits, we show the same result but the minimal hypersurfaces may be immersed. As a result, any closed Riemmanian manifold with cohomogeneity $2$ Lie group action and no exceptional orbits admits a minimal hypersurface with optimal regularity. A key tool is the regularity theory of Chodosh--Mantoulidis, building on the work of Wang--Wei. However, we adapt their arguments to a modified Allen--Cahn equation with a drift Laplacian. We also show that appropriate index bounds hold for the limiting minimal hypersurface when it is smooth.   We also extend the variational constructions of solutions of the Allen--Cahn equation of Guaraco and Gaspar--Guaraco by defining an equivariant mountain pass invariant, as well as the equivariant Allen--Cahn $p$-widths. This builds on the work of Gromov and is the Allen--Cahn parallel to Wang's equivariant volume spectrum in the Almgren-Pitts setting. We show that in the limit as $ε$ tends to $0$, the equivariant Allen--Cahn $p$-widths converge to the equivariant $p$-widths, as defined by Wang.

papers.title_en: Ball and Spherical-Shell Rigidity from Overdetermined Translating Solitons
papers.evidence: 图形平移孤子方程的超定边值问题，属于几何偏微分方程
papers.tldr: 针对图形翻译孤子方程过定边界问题，研究有界域和双连通域的刚性。通过线性化反射、临界平面、环形延拓原理及曲率比较等方法，证明常数Dirichlet数据迫使正则有界域为球，并建立双连通域球形壳刚性定理。给出的反例表明符号、序、连通性和嵌套假设的尖锐性。
papers.abstract_en: We study overdetermined boundary problems for the graphical translating-soliton equation \[ -\operatorname{div}\!\left(\frac{Du}{\sqrt{1+|Du|^2}}\right) =\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+|Du|^2}} \quad\text{in }Ω, \qquad \partial_νu=ΓH+C \quad\text{on }\partialΩ, \] where $Γ, C$ are constants, $H$ is the mean curvature of the boundary $\partialΩ$ of the regular bounded domain in $R^n$ such that $H_{\partial B_R}=-1/R$. For $Γ\geq0$, we prove that constant Dirichlet data force a bounded domain to be a ball. We also prove a spherical-shell rigidity theorem for a doubly connected domain with two ordered boundary heights and $a<u<b$ in the interior. The argument combines linearization under reflection, Reichel's critical-plane and annular continuation principles, curvature comparison, Serrin's corner lemma, and a radial ODE that excludes the annular alternative in the one-height problem. Finally, we give explicit counterexamples showing the sharpness of the sign, ordering, connectedness, and nesting assumptions.
